63:t_1:87.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[That is her name.]

63:t_1:89.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$... So your name is $$レド$$.」

63:t_1:90.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See? I knew he'd be hungry.」

63:t_1:91.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yep, yep. First things first, people need to eat.」

63:t_1:94.en:
$$甲児$$
「We can talk it over afterward, nice and slow.」

63:t_1:95.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've got plenty besides dried fish, so eat up!」

63:t_1:97.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Judging by their voices, they are inferred to be soldiers who took part in yesterday's operation. They wish to establish friendly relations with Ensign $$レド$$.]

63:t_1:100.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Communication with a different civilization... Come to think of it, that's something we've done many times already in this multiverse...」

63:t_1:101.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I think we can join hands with him, just as this fleet and we did.」

63:t_1:106.en:
$$アル$$
「...Now then, I will begin hearing your account of the circumstances.」

63:t_1:108.en:
$$アル$$
「I am the control AI of the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$. My name is $$アル$$.」

63:t_1:109.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am this unit's Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

63:t_1:110.en:
$$アル$$
「Nice to meet you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

63:t_1:111.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Request. Present the meaning of 'nice to meet you'.」

63:t_1:112.en:
$$アル$$
「It is a phrase expressing affection, or friendship. Your vocabulary seems to be lopsided as well.」

63:t_1:113.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「At present, we are collecting data for our judgment. Your cooperation is requested.」

63:t_1:114.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. Let us strive for each other's sake.」

63:t_1:116.en:
$$正太郎$$
「They're hearing $$レド$$'s account of the circumstances.」

63:t_1:117.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is $$アル$$ doing it because they're both robots?」

63:t_1:119.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Since it's an AI, I think it can gather accurate information without any needless subjectivity.」

63:t_1:122.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure, $$アル$$ is an AI, and when it comes to gathering information accurately it beats any human, but saying it has no subjectivity is a bit off, I think.」

63:t_1:123.en:
$$かなめ$$
「For example, in a chess match between a human and a computer, the AI side picks the optimal move from a huge amount of data, but...」

63:t_1:124.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$アル$$ seems to tend to put its own intuition ahead of checking against past data.」

63:t_1:126.en:
$$ルカ$$
「You mean it's just like a human?」

63:t_1:127.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. Spending these past few days with $$アル$$, that's how it felt to me...」

63:t_1:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Though here I am saying it on intuition myself.」

63:t_1:129.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well... we'll leave that side to $$アル$$, and the problem is over here.」

63:t_1:136.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Unlike their robots, the pilots aren't hitting it off at all.」

63:t_1:137.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I heard $$レド$$ is a soldier devoted to his duty, so I thought they'd get along...」

63:t_1:138.en:
$n
「No... two brooding types aren't going to click.」

63:t_1:139.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you saying? $n and $$宗介$$ are both brooding types too, and you two get along great.」

63:t_1:140.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$ワッ太$$... I've been meaning to ask. Do I really... come across as that brooding?」

63:t_1:143.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Well... in $n's case... it's more that you're reserved, or quiet, or composed...」

63:t_1:144.en:
$n
「...Thanks, $$正太郎$$... But right now, that kindness only makes it hurt more...」

63:t_1:145.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's a first-impression thing. To be fair, $n... when you'd just transferred in, you gave off a cool, unapproachable vibe.」

63:t_1:146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... these days the moderately dopey side of you has started to show, though.」

63:t_1:147.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't think that's much of a comfort...」

63:t_1:148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it. This kind of thing is basically all in how you look at it.」

63:t_1:150.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If it bugs you so much to be called brooding, go get that $$レド$$ to open up his heart.」

63:t_1:151.en:
$n
「...I'm not falling for that. You're trying to dump the hassle on me, just like you did with $$宗介$$, aren't you?」

63:t_1:152.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ha... hahaha... As if I'd ever do that.」

63:t_1:154.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ugh... can't fool your eyes, $$正太郎$$...」

63:t_1:155.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right then... time to show you how communication is done.」

63:t_1:156.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$ is the better match to partner with a brooding type.」

63:t_1:157.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... so it bothered you more than I thought, $n.」

63:t_1:158.en:
$n
「...Until I came to $$陣代高校$$, I'd barely ever had a proper conversation with anyone but my father and my sister...」

63:t_1:159.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Because you were a $$ビーストハンター$$ in the mountains?」

63:t_1:161.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Come to think of it, I heard about 《$$ご家族の事故$$》, but he hardly ever tells me anything from before that...)

63:t_1:169.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Mind if I sit next to you?」

63:t_1:171.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you finished interviewing Ensign $$レド$$?」
